label: Founded populated pasts from Grim Reaper pieces and patchwork
meaning: Non-transcription conditional support option for A3 prime a (founded populated pasts), replacing the near-transcription Reaper assembly route. Suppose a contingent concrete thing is present at t in an accessible history and t has no founded past; dependent choice gives a strictly descending sequence c from t. The local premise makes every two adjacent Reaper pieces along c co-possible; patchwork gives one accessible world u realizing all of them. Translating u's register codes into the indices of the stations they name (the descent is injective) yields a Nat-indexed signal and issuance satisfying index admissibility, positive trigger, emission and forwarding, which the verified IndexedSignalReaper.impossible refutes. Neither premise mentions foundedness, and each holds without the other in a beginningless integer history (controls 1 and 2). Because both premises range over every descent, they also exclude contingent presence after the first moment of dense time with a beginning (control 3): the unrestricted premises carry the same anti-continuum commitment as founded populated pasts. Both premises are OPEN; the arrangement's impossibility is mathematics, the possibility of the pieces and their gluing is the disputed metaphysics. Nothing is attributed to Koons or Pruss. No premise is established.
